# tebibcloud_instance_types (Data Source)

VM sizes (instance types), smallest first as the API lists them. See `tebibcloud_prices` for what they cost.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tebibcloud_instance_types" "four_cpus" {
  min_vcpus = 4
}

output "smallest_with_four_cpus" {
  value = data.tebibcloud_instance_types.four_cpus.names[0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `family` (String) Only this family.
- `min_memory_mib` (Number) Only types with at least this much memory.
- `min_vcpus` (Number) Only types with at least this many vCPUs.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Default: the provider's `project`.

### Read-Only

- `instance_types` (Attributes List) The instance types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instance_types))
- `names` (List of String) Names, for `tebibcloud_vm.instance_type`.

<a id="nestedatt--instance_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instance_types`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `family` (String) Family.
- `memory_mib` (Number) Memory in MiB.
- `name` (String) Name, for `tebibcloud_vm.instance_type`.
- `retire_after` (String) When a retiring type stops being offered (RFC 3339), empty if it is not retiring.
- `schedulable` (Boolean) A VM of this size can be created and started right now (advisory: creating decides).
- `vcpus` (Number) vCPUs.
- `visibility` (String) `active`, or `retiring` (still offered until `retire_after`).
